title: Adding/changing a product URL: manifest → generated products.tsx → scenes redirects
answers: How do I add or change a URL in a product?
Where do redirects for old paths go?
Which files are generated for product routing?
body:
- Define builder in `products/<name>/manifest.tsx` `urls`, route in `routes` as `[SceneName, sceneKey]`, scene in `scenes` (`ProductManifest` in frontend/src/types.ts).
- `frontend/build-products.mjs` combines manifests into generated `frontend/src/products.tsx` (`productRoutes`, `productRedirects`, productUrls), plus `productScenes.tsx` and `products.json`. Header: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Regenerate with `pnpm build:products` (frontend/package.json); root lint-staged runs it and git-adds those three files.
- Exception: new icon/other imports used in a manifest aren't copied; add them by hand once in `frontend/src/products.tsx` (products/README.md, Manual setup).
- Renamed path: add old path to `manifest.redirects` (product) or `frontend/src/scenes/scenes.ts:redirects` (core; it spreads `...productRedirects`).
- String redirects drop query/hash; use function form `(params, searchParams, hashParams) => string` (e.g. `/code_review` with `combineUrl`) to keep them. Auto-forward params via `scenes.ts:forwardedRedirectQueryParams` (currently ['modal']).
- Don't let a redirect shadow a path that still has its own scene (e.g. `/billing/authorization_status`).
- `frontend/src/scenes/urls.ts` merges `productUrls` from `~/products`; quirky builders get tests in `frontend/src/scenes/urls.test.ts`.
- API generated types (frontend/src/generated/core, products/*/frontend/generated) regenerate via `hogli build:openapi`.
applies: Product-based routing; core scenes are edited directly in scenes.ts/appScenes.ts.
